371:t_1:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
(So $c has headed to Japan... If I don't finish them off there, I truly have no chance left.)

371:t_1:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Isn't there any useful data...? Something that might expose their weakness...)

371:t_1:10.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「It's been a while, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

371:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It has indeed, $$兵左衛門$$. I'm glad to see you're well.」

371:t_1:12.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「I can't offer much, but you should replenish some of your supplies here.」

371:t_1:13.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「I'll also put you in touch with the resistance groups in Japan and the $$中央大陸$$ later.」

371:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Thank you for everything you're doing for us.」

371:t_1:15.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「You did so much for us in the $$多元戦争$$. And now you're looking after $$勝平$$ and the others too.」

371:t_1:16.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「I've left the $$ビアル$$ to $$源五郎$$ and the others. I'm retired now, but you can leave this much to me.」

371:t_1:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「What are you talking about, Grandpa? You're advising resistance groups all over the place!」

371:t_1:18.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「These are the times we live in. If this old man can be of use, I'll gladly help.」

371:t_1:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's just what I'd expect from the elder of the $$神ファミリー$$. You've got real presence.」

371:t_1:20.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「So you're $$ワッ太$$. I hear you looked after $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, and $$恵子$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

371:t_1:21.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Oh, no, $$兵左衛門$$. $$宇宙太$$'s accounting skills and $$恵子$$'s office skills were a great help to our company.」

371:t_1:22.en:
$$柿小路$$
「If either of them is ever unsure of their career path, please encourage them to consider joining $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

371:t_1:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... So you don't care about me, Executive Director?」

371:t_1:24.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「All you were good for was being $$ワッ太$$'s playmate.」

371:t_1:25.en:
$$恵子$$
「But when we have peace, couldn't we use $$ザンボット$$ as an all-purpose robot like $$トライダー$$?」

371:t_1:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah. Instead of joining $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, maybe I should start $$神グレートカンパニー$$ then.」

371:t_1:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「Well, I'll make at least as much money as some bumbling president I know.」

371:t_1:28.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You asked for it, $$イナカッペイ$$!」

371:t_1:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Why, you...! You had to go and call me that!」

371:t_1:30.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're the one who picked a fight first!」

371:t_1:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! Don't act so high and mighty just because we were your employees for a little while!」

371:t_1:32.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I hired you out of kindness! How can you talk about it like that!?」

371:t_1:33.en:
$$赤木$$
「Stop it, both of you! What good will fighting here do!?」

371:t_1:34.en:
$$勝平$$
「Stay out of it, Big Bro $$赤木$$!」

371:t_1:35.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's right! My pride and honor as president are on the line in this fight!」

371:t_1:36.en:
$$柿小路$$
「What should we do, $$兵左衛門$$?」

371:t_1:37.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Just leave them be. They'll settle down on their own once they're hungry.」

371:t_1:38.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「They look like good friends and good rivals to me, after all.」

371:t_1:39.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Come to think of it, $$ザンボット３$$ and $$トライダーＧ７$$ use related technology, don't they...?」

371:t_1:40.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Oh... I haven't introduced myself. I'm $$神一太郎$$... $$勝平$$'s older brother.」

371:t_1:41.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$勝平$$ has told us about you.」

371:t_1:42.en:
$$青山$$
「He said, 'Unlike me, my brother's got his act together'... or something like that.」

371:t_1:43.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Oh, no... I can't compare with $$勝平$$, fighting on the front lines in $$ザンボット$$.」

371:t_1:44.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Weren't you working with the resistance alongside our dads, $$一太郎$$?」

371:t_1:45.en:
$$一太郎$$
「I'm currently working as an engineer, researching the technology of planet $$ビアル星$$.」

371:t_1:46.en:
$$一太郎$$
「I've found all sorts of interesting documents.」

371:t_1:47.en:
$$恵子$$
「Are they ancient writings left behind by the $$ビアル星人$$?」

371:t_1:48.en:
$$一太郎$$
「No. Someone who knows about planet $$ビアル星$$'s technology helped me.」

371:t_1:50.en:
$$一太郎$$
「This person wouldn't tell me anything about their background, but gave the name $$梅本$$.」

371:t_1:52.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$一太郎$$! Was he... a man with a big, bushy beard!?」

371:t_1:54.en:
$$厚井$$
「So it was that $$梅本$$ after all...」

371:t_1:55.en:
$$木下$$
「He certainly did know about $$ザンボット３$$'s mechanisms too...」

371:t_1:56.en:
$$郁絵$$
「I never imagined he was on $$翠の地球$$...」

371:t_1:57.en:
$$厚井$$
「Hmm... He's as elusive as ever.」

371:t_1:58.en:
$$一太郎$$
「You're Managing Director $$厚井$$ of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, right? If you don't mind, could you show me $$トライダー$$'s blueprints?」

371:t_1:59.en:
$$一太郎$$
「There might be something we can use to improve $$ザンボット$$.」

371:t_1:61.en:
$$木下$$
「The President is still over there fighting with $$勝平$$.」

371:t_1:62.en:
$$厚井$$
「Then I'll handle this with the responsible director's approval. ...Of course, $$一太郎$$.」

371:t_1:63.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh! With Big Bro $$イチ$$ working on it, $$ザンボット$$ will get even stronger than $$トライダー$$!」

371:t_1:64.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But with $$勝平$$ piloting it, all that power will go to waste!」

371:t_1:67.en:
$$赤木$$
「I said, stop it already, both of you!」

371:t_1:68.en:
$$いぶき$$
「They just never get tired of it...」

371:t_1:69.en:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$'s pretty impressive too, keeping up with a children's squabble like that.」

371:t_1:70.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「In any case, you must be tired from your long journey. Rest a little here in Japan first.」

371:t_1:71.en:
$$勝平$$
「Come eat at our place first! My mom's oden is tastier than $$ワッ太$$'s mom's croquettes!」

371:t_1:72.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about!? You said my mom's croquettes were the best in all the parallel worlds!」

371:t_1:73.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then let's have the Managing Director decide which tastes better!」

371:t_1:75.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm counting on you, Managing Director! Give us a big, flashy verdict!」

371:t_1:76.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Oh, $$勝平$$. Mom and Grandma are out.」

371:t_1:78.en:
$$一太郎$$
「They're volunteering at the refugee camp in Fuji.」

371:t_1:84.en:
$$梅江$$
「Well, well, $$チュウ$$ and $$恵子$$ are here too.」

371:t_1:85.en:
$$勝平$$
「You both look well, Mom, Grandma.」

371:t_1:86.en:
$$恵子$$
「We heard you were both volunteering here, so we came to help.」

371:t_1:87.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「And we brought some extra hands too.」

371:t_1:88.en:
$$花江$$
「If the President $$ワッ太$$ I've heard so much about is here too, I should say hello.」
